name: ElevenLabs
shortDescription: AI voice generator and text to speech.
bestFor: The most natural AI voice-overs, voice cloning and dubbing
about: ElevenLabs turns text into very natural speech. It is the most popular tool for voice-overs on YouTube, audiobooks, ads and apps.
You can choose from a large voice library, clone your own voice (with permission), dub videos into other languages, and make sound effects.
useCases: Dub a video into another language
Clone your own voice for content
features: Very natural text to speech in many languages

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.text: Create a free account at elevenlabs.io.

howToUse.title: Open Text to Speech
howToUse.text: Paste your script into the text box.

howToUse.title: Choose a voice
howToUse.text: Pick a voice from the library that fits your content.

howToUse.title: Adjust settings
howToUse.text: Change stability and style. Lower stability sounds more expressive, higher sounds more even.

howToUse.title: Generate and download
howToUse.text: Listen, regenerate lines that sound wrong, and download the audio.

tips: Use commas and full stops to control pauses.
Generate long scripts in parts so you can fix single lines.
Only clone voices you have permission to use.
limitations: The free plan can't be used commercially and requires credit to ElevenLabs.
Urdu pronunciation can be uneven. Test before you publish.
freePlanDetails: 10,000 credits per month. No commercial use.
pricingNote: US prices. App store prices in Pakistan may be different.

name: Murf AI
shortDescription: Text to speech studio for voice-overs in videos and presentations.
bestFor: Clean, professional voice-overs for business videos and presentations
about: Murf AI is a voice-over studio. You paste a script, pick a voice, and line it up with your video or slides on a timeline.
It is aimed at business use, such as training, explainers and ads, and has controls for pitch, speed and emphasis on single words.
features: Timeline to sync voice with video
Control of pitch, speed and emphasis

howToUse.title: Create a project
howToUse.text: Start a new project and paste your script.

howToUse.title: Choose a voice
howToUse.text: Pick a voice and listen to samples.

howToUse.title: Fine-tune
howToUse.text: Add pauses, change speed and emphasise key words.

howToUse.title: Export
howToUse.text: Download the audio, or the video if you added one.

tips: Use the pronunciation tool for brand names and local names.
Keep a consistent voice across a series of videos.
limitations: Voice time on the cheapest plan is about 2 hours a month.
Downloads and commercial use need a paid plan.
freePlanDetails: A free plan to try voices, with limited generation.
pricingNote: US prices. Sources showed slightly different plan names, so check the website.

name: Speechify
shortDescription: Reads any text, PDF or web page aloud in a natural voice.
bestFor: Listening to books, PDFs and articles instead of reading them
about: Speechify reads text aloud. It works with PDFs, web pages, documents, emails and photos of printed pages, on phone, computer and as a browser extension.
Many students and people with dyslexia use it to study faster by listening.
useCases: Listen to study notes and PDFs
Proofread your own writing by ear
features: Scan printed pages with your camera

howToUse.title: Install
howToUse.text: Install the app or the Chrome extension from speechify.com.

howToUse.title: Add something to read
howToUse.text: Open a PDF, a web page, or take a photo of a page.

howToUse.title: Press play
howToUse.text: Choose a voice and speed, and listen.

howToUse.title: Speed up over time
howToUse.text: Increase the speed slowly as you get used to listening.

tips: Listening while you read along helps you remember more.
Use the browser extension to listen to long articles.
limitations: The free plan has fewer voices and lower speeds.
Premium is expensive if you pay monthly.
pricingNote: US prices. Speechify Studio, for voice-overs, is a separate product.
